content.short: Stablecoin wallet with virtual accounts, transfers and spending.
content.description: Stables is a global money app, headquartered in Australia, that lets people manage, save, and spend US dollars held as regulated stablecoins across more than 150 countries. Users hold balances backed 1:1 by USDC and USDT, get virtual account details for receiving funds, send low-cost cross-border transfers, and spend instantly with a Stables Visa card accepted at over 150 million merchants and ATMs, with an online card powered by Polygon. Serving both consumers and businesses, Stables focuses on giving people in markets with volatile currencies or limited dollar access a simple, self-custody-adjacent way to keep money in stable dollars and use it in everyday life. By pairing a stablecoin wallet with virtual accounts and card spending, Stables turns digital dollars into a practical global bank-account alternative.
content.meta: Stables is a global USD money app for holding and spending stablecoins via a Visa card. Discover Stables and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
